> **As of 2026-10-29.** A plain session is a `claude` started on [[Carbon]] without `aide-launch.sh`: no `WM_SEAT`, no seat sid, no AIDE CARD. It is Joe's own session, fleet-neutral, and may be non-mcphost work (Joe 10-23 12:3x PM; approvals #21). It is not the [[Aide Seat]] and not one of the unit-driven seats in [[Operator Seats]]. Its job is the task Joe asked for; fleet causes it notices go to the aide inbox once.
